answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 972 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: If we listen recitations of Quran from audiotape, whether we get the same reward as mentioned in Hadiths? Question: If we listen recitations of Quran from audiotape, whether we get the same reward as mentioned in Hadiths? Answer ID: 972 Posted on: May 15, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 467=455/N) Listening to recitation of the Quran from audiotape is neither as much rewarded as listening it directly from a Qari (who recites the Holy Quran) nor has it the same rulings. However, it is an act of virtue and reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
